تنتهزين (form VIII)
# تَنْتَهِزِينَ (tantahizīna) /tan.ta.hi.ziː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَهَزَ (intahaza)
# تُنْتَهَزِينَ (tuntahazīna) /tun.ta.ha.ziː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَهَزَ (intahaza)
